answer: Resist Sybils with simultaneous-presence proof: standing grows only when an identity is verified live, at overlapping times, in independent venues — a timber workshop, a harbour inlet office, and a terrace market — each checked by unrelated operators sharing no funding or staff. One operator cannot attend three live checks at once, and replays fail because each venue asks a fresh, time-bound question on the spot. Every fake therefore needs its own live presence, in its own venue, at the same moment, turning mass fakery into a staffing problem rather than a copying trick.
